definitions.explanation: Specialized words or phrases used in a particular field, subject, or profession.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医学|いがく}→医学：01301_igaku⟧{用語|ようご}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{用語|ようご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意味|いみ}→意味：01155_imi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: I don't understand the meaning of this term.

examples.japanese: ⟦{専門|せんもん}→専門：01251_senmon⟧{用語|ようご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}わずに→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}して→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please explain without using technical terms.

notes:
{用語|ようご} refers to specialized words or phrases used in a particular field or profession. Broader than ⟦{術語|じゅつご}→術語：28410_jutsugo⟧ (strict technical term).

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{専門|せんもん}→専門：01251_senmon⟧{用語|ようご}: technical terminology
- ⟦{医学|いがく}→医学：01301_igaku⟧{用語|ようご}: medical terminology
- ⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧{用語|ようご}: legal terminology
- IT{用語|ようご}: IT terminology
- {用語|ようご}⟦{集|しゅう}→集：noentry⟧: glossary
- {用語|ようご}⟦{解説|かいせつ}→解説：00138_kaisetsu⟧: terminology explanation

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {用語|ようご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use terminology
- {用語|ようご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意味|いみ}→意味：01155_imi⟧: meaning of a term
- {用語|ようご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧: to learn terminology

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{術語|じゅつご}→術語：28410_jutsugo⟧: technical term (more formal, narrower)
- ⟦{語彙|ごい}→語彙：14214_goi⟧: vocabulary (general, not field-specific)
- ⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧: word (everyday)
